_about: The lessons of this site that the Prep Tracker (/tracker/) lists under a study item. "items" is found by scripts/tracker/match-lessons.mjs from the words of each item and each written lesson (run `npm run tracker:lessons`); "drop" and "add" are what a person decided after reading those matches and are kept when it runs again; "steps" are the lessons for a step of a design problem (the same for every problem), and "problems" the lessons for one design problem. Every path must be a written lesson: scripts/build/gen-tracker.mjs stops the build when one is not.
